Data Analytics Intern (Summer 2027)
Larkspur Transit Authority | Columbus, OH

About Us
Larkspur Transit Authority runs bus and paratransit service for more than 40 communities. Our mission is to make every trip on time and easy to plan.

About the Internship
This is a paid ten-week internship on the planning team. You will work with analysts who study ridership and schedules.

What You'll Do
• Clean and combine ridership data from fare systems and on-board counters
• Build weekly dashboards in Tableau for the service planning team
• Write SQL queries to answer questions from route planners
• Present findings to stakeholders at the end of the summer
• Other duties as assigned

What We're Looking For
• Currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree program in statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field
• Experience with Excel, including pivot tables and lookups
• Coursework or class projects using SQL
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment as a self-starter

Nice to Have
• Python or R for data analysis
• Familiarity with GIS tools
• An interest in public transportation

Benefits
• Paid internship at $20 per hour
• Free transit pass for the summer

Larkspur Transit Authority is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.
